caption: feeNumerator is basis points over 10,000 -- 500 means a 5% royalty.

code:
royaltyInfo(tokenId, salePrice) -> (receiver, amount)

salePrice = 10 ETH, feeNumerator = 500 (5%)
royaltyAmount = 10 ETH x (500 / 10,000) = 0.5 ETH

Seller receives:   10 - 0.5 = 9.5 ETH
Creator receives:  0.5 ETH
(marketplace may also take its own fee on top)
